One line for every roofing service in Dallas

The roofing companies you reach through this line handle the full range of residential and commercial roof work. DFW Expert Roofers itself does none of it; it answers your call and connects you. The pages below explain each kind of work so you can talk to the roofer with a clear idea of what you need.

The services fall into four groups. Most homeowners call about a repair (a leak, a few missing shingles, flashing that let go), about storm damage after hail or wind, about a replacement when the roof is at the end of its life, or about a commercial or low-slope roof on a business, church or garage.

What every service has in common

Whatever the job, a few things should be the same. The roofer inspects before quoting. The quote is in writing and lists materials by brand and product line. The roofer can show you proof of liability insurance from its agent. If your city requires a permit, the roofer pulls it in its own name. And nobody asks you to sign on the spot or offers to cover your insurance deductible.

Many roofers inspect without charging; ask about that on the call, since policies differ from company to company.

  1. Dial the lineAn automated assistant picks up (469) 649-7066 any time and asks what you need. The same number also takes air conditioning, heating and pressure washing calls, so say "roof".
  2. Tell it about the roofHail, a drip in the ceiling, shingles in the yard, a tree limb, or an aging roof you want checked, plus your town and how soon you need someone.
  3. Get transferredThe call goes to an independent roofing company that is locally owned and works in Dallas-Fort Worth. It hears a quick summary of your call before it answers.
  4. Work with that companyIt inspects, prices and does the job, and you pay it (or your insurer does, as you arrange). If it cannot pick up, it gets your name, number, town and need so it can call you back.

No state license for roofers. Texas does not license roofing contractors. A 2025 bill that would have had the state license re-roofers (HB 3344) cleared a House committee but never got a floor vote, and it died when the session ended. That puts the checking on you: ask for a certificate of liability insurance sent to you by the roofer's insurance agent or insurer, a written contract that lists the full scope, the permit or contractor registration your city requires, addresses of nearby jobs, and proof the shingle warranty was registered. The line does none of this checking for you. How to check a roofer in Texas.

Questions North Texas homeowners ask

What does a roofing service in Dallas usually include?

It depends on the job. A repair visit typically covers finding the cause, replacing damaged shingles, flashing or pipe boots, and sealing the area. A replacement covers tear-off, decking repairs, underlayment, flashing, ventilation, new roofing and cleanup, plus a permit where the city requires one. The roofing company you reach should put the exact scope in writing. See roof repair and roof replacement.

Should I repair my roof or replace it?

Repair usually makes sense for damage limited to one area on a roof with years left. Replacement makes more sense when damage is spread across many slopes, the shingles are brittle or curling, or leaks keep returning. After hail, the answer often depends on what the adjuster finds. Before deciding, have the roofer walk you through pictures of every problem it found.

Do roofers here work on commercial buildings too?

Many do, but commercial roofs are a different trade: TPO, modified bitumen, built-up, metal and coatings on low-slope roofs. Say on the call that it is a commercial building so you are connected with a company that handles that work. The commercial roofing page covers what owners should ask.

Is there a roofing service for emergencies at night?

The line answers at night and transfers you to a roofing company in your area. Whether it can send a crew right away depends on the company and the weather; no one can safely work on a roof in lightning or heavy rain. A temporary tarp is the usual first step. See emergency roof repair and tarping.

Not sure which service you need? Describe it on the phone

Say what the roof is doing and which town you are in. The automated assistant passes you to an independent roofing company that is locally owned and works in DFW. That company comes out, looks at the roof and prices the job itself.
